description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget named SettingsFragment, which presents a settings screen with options like Profile, Favorites, App Language, Shortcuts, About, Subscribe to Beta, and Logout. It is a stateless widget that builds a list view containing various setting items, including navigation to other screens such as LanguageScreen and OTPValidationScreen, using Flutter's Navigator. It also reads preferences via PreferenceHelper to determine the current language setting and displays it accordingly. The file includes internal helper method `_buildSettingsItem` to construct list tiles for each setting.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A comprehensive Flutter StatelessWidget that renders a configurable settings screen with several options and navigation logic.

methods.name: _buildSettingsItem
methods.description: Internal helper method to create a styled ListTile widget for a setting item, with customizable icon, title, optional subtitle, trailing widget, title color, and tap callback.

methods.name: _showLogoutDialog
methods.description: Private method to display a confirmation dialog for logout, handle user confirmation by clearing preferences and navigating to OTPValidationScreen.
